title: Johnson Investment Counsel
description:
Johnson Investment Counsel is an independent, employee-owned wealth management firm founded in 1965 and headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. The company provides comprehensive financial services to individuals, families, businesses, corporations, retirement plans, foundations, and nonprofit organizations. Its services include investment management, financial planning, retirement and cash-flow planning, estate planning, trust services, charitable planning, and business solutions. Johnson Investment Counsel operates as a fee-only Registered Investment Advisor and emphasizes fiduciary responsibility, long-term relationships, and customized financial strategies. As of June 30, 2026, the firm manages approximately $23 billion in assets and has 159 employees, serving clients across all 50 U.S. states. 
The company headquarters is located in 7755 Montgomery Road, Suite 180, Cincinnati, OH 45236, United States.51-200 Employees
